title: Nuclear test sites with Marines dug in nearby

tellings.quote: they detonated nukes where they had the Marines like embedded right next to where the the explosions were going off

plain: A man named Randy Anderson, who says he saw alien technology at a military base, says that in the 1950s at the Nevada Test Site, the desert area where the US tested nuclear bombs, the military set off nuclear blasts with Marines dug in right next to them. He tells it as part of the hidden history of that secret region of Nevada, near Area 51, a secret Air Force base.
